title: Carina: portrait round 7 (round 6 tile 3, calmer eyes and expression)
question: Is any of these calm enough, and which expression words should I keep or change next?

media.caption: Base first: round 6 tile 3 (hair 2, roots + stripes), your pick: "3. hair 2, roots + stripes pretty good". You said about the prompt: "both eyes visible, looking at the viewer, (confident slight smile:1.2) probably too much, teh eyes are intense", and about round 6: "she looks unhinged". Every tile keeps hair 2 and the seed 10496 and changes only eye and expression words: removing 'both eyes visible', a plain 'slight smile' without the weight, and one calm-eye phrase per tile ('relaxed eyes', 'half-lidded eyes', 'gentle eyes'). No post-processing. Honest result: the wide pale eyes with white round the iris barely change; tiles marked red in the label still read as a stare. Only 4 and 5 (remove the word, plain smile, plus 'relaxed eyes' or 'half-lidded eyes') get slightly lower lids, and their second seeds are wide again. Probably the wide look comes from other words (pale grey eyes, wide-set eyes weighted 1.5, long eyelashes, strong defined brows) rather than these. I did not touch those, as asked.
